fusions.name: Round the Corner
fusions.desc: Fires a curved shot that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets, then ricochets to 1 more enemy within 4 tiles for 60% of that. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Buckshot Harvest
fusions.desc: Fires a spray 5 tiles ahead that deals 12 damage to everything in it and stuns each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Longer Barrel
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 32% further.

fusions.name: Second Report
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a second shot strikes the nearest enemy within 9 tiles for 8 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
